metadata.short_desc: Reaches out on its own only when something is really on its mind, with hard limits
metadata.desc: The persona reaches out on its own when something is really on its mind (missing you, something worth sharing, your plans, its own mistakes), with hard limits; other thoughts wait until you come back. Needs memory-core.

mind.title: Thoughts
mind.description: What went through her mind, whether she said it, what she keeps for later
